page: Microsoft Azure D96ads_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine built on AMD EPYC 7763 processors under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The configuration provides 96 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 48 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading at up to 3.7 GHz. The system includes 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a standard balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware features include 3865 GB of local SSD temporary storage, support for premium storage, and basic cryptographic extensions like AES, VAES, and SHA-NI, while excluding AVX-512 and AMX instruction sets.

Benchmark outcomes demonstrate superior performance in multi-threaded computation and cryptographic tasks. The multi-core stress-ng metric reaches 129,510.01 and PassMark CPU encryption scores hit 102,778.7, placing both within the top 10% tier. Multi-core Geekbench performance (16,536.0) and software compilation using Clang (52,501.0) achieve top-quartile status. In contrast, single-threaded processing presents average results, with Geekbench single-core scoring 1,568.0 and text processing scoring 1,904.0. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth registers at 124.17 GB/sec, while cached 16 KB read throughput sustains 6,255.43 GB/sec.

With 3,865 GB of direct-attached local SSD and 384 GB of memory, this instance yields high resource density for scale-up architectures. Data operations reflect this profile, maintaining 26,306.56 on PassMark database tests and 93.33 million operations per second on Redis SET benchmarks. The system lacks discrete GPU accelerators, which restricts its utility for high-throughput LLM text generation (generating 2.95 tokens per second on a 70B parameter model). This instance is suitable for high-concurrency relational and in-memory databases, large Clang compilation builds, multi-threaded batch operations, and heavy enterprise application backends.
description: Microsoft Azure D96ads_v5 is a general-purpose instance featuring 96 vCPUs (48 physical cores) powered by AMD EPYC 7763 processors clocked up to 3.7 GHz. It integrates 384.0 GB of RAM and 3,865 GB of direct-attached local SSD storage. Evaluated across synthetic and application benchmarks, the server excels in multi-threaded workloads, achieving top-tier results in stress-ng multi-core tests (129,510.01) and PassMark encryption (102,778.7), alongside strong outcomes in Clang compilation and multi-threaded decompression. Single-core performance remains mid-tier, with a Geekbench score of 1,568.0. Given its massive core count, integrated high-capacity local disk, and balanced 4 GB per vCPU ratio, the instance is well suited for demanding database operations, concurrent web application hosting, build systems, and enterprise data processing environments that require substantial local caching and multi-threaded parallelism.
